why: Remembered as the rule that the risk of loss of a thing to be delivered passes to the debtor once he is put on notice; articles 165 to 173 are missing from the store.
Law on the bailiff profession: remembered as listing the bailiff's power to serve warnings and extrajudicial acts, the usual means of a formal notice under Civil Code article 180.
The French edition makes the risk of the thing pass to the debtor after notice; not in the store.
Art. 180 sends to the postal form of notice 'as set out in this code'; the provision on that form was not found in the store.

Attack adv-4: the insurer's notice to pay a premium (contracts renewed automatically) is by registered letter with acknowledgement of receipt, within 30 days after the 15-day term; cover suspended after 30 days; rescission 10 days after suspension. Open point o11 (grade D).

why: Attack adv-5: interest for each day of delay on an insurance indemnity not paid within the periods of the general conditions; a candidate contrary text under Civil Code art. 179. Open point o12 (grade D).

why: Attack adv-8: rules of public-housing leases (kept by Civil Code art. 507 مكرر 1); Supreme Court decision 1094447 of 15-03-2018 (coursupreme.dz) rests on this article to hold that refusing to execute a rent judgment dispenses with notice.
